The '''2021 Minnesota Tournament Season''' was a series of Minnesota events organized by [[Mark Walseth]] over three weekends in 2021, with a Saturday event using modified printed Decipher cards (plus Virtual Defensive Shields) and a Sunday constructed Swiss event each weekend. 21 different players played at least one event. The final weekend was 7–8 August 2021; [[Cory Lauer|Cory]] won its Saturday event, and two-time World Champion [[Jonny Chu]] visited as an out-of-state guest and finished third.<ref name="mn21">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=78765 MN 2021 Tournament Season (Round 3 - Final)], forum.starwarsccg.org (28 July – 11 August 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005132/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t78765.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Minnesota<ref name="mn21" />
* '''Dates:''' Three weekends; final weekend 7–8 August 2021<ref name="mn21" />
* '''Structure:''' Saturday: modified printed Decipher cards only, plus Virtual Defensive Shields; Sunday: 4 games Swiss constructed<ref name="mn21" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="mn21" />

Will T, new to the Minnesota community that season, won a Decipher Gold Squadron bag. The organizer noted that the winners of all three Saturday events were not the usual tournament winners.<ref name="mn21" />
